# Komboe

> Komboe is an open-source, zero-knowledge password manager (pre-release). Vaults are encrypted on-device with Encryptoglyph (Apache-2.0); vault contents are end-to-end encrypted on the device before upload, so Komboe can't read vault data; some account metadata is processed as described in the Privacy Policy (https://komboe.com/privacy.html). The master password never leaves the device, there is no backdoor and no admin password reset. One Komboe account (email + master password, optional passkey and 2FA) covers the web vault, browser extensions, Android, desktop, CLI and an MCP agent integration. iOS is planned. Paid prices and release builds are not yet published.

## Self-hosting
A self-hosted Komboe server does not contact Komboe. It also does not contact Bitwarden, GitHub, Cloudflare, or the websites in the vault unless you turn that on. Desktop and CLI update checks stay off until you point them at a feed you host. Have I Been Pwned is contacted only when you start a check yourself: opening the exposed-passwords report or pressing the breach-check button on a login. Each check sends only a k-anonymity hash prefix, never the password. The web vault uses the server it was loaded from. Until you save a server URL, the browser extension, desktop, CLI and Android apps default to the upstream Bitwarden cloud servers. Set your server URL when you first sign in. Switches: https://github.com/GoDeskio/Komboe/blob/main/docs/RUNNING.md
